name: DETECTLANGUAGE
description: DETECTLANGUAGE identifies the language of a given text and returns the two-letter language code.
tldr: DETECTLANGUAGE tells you what language a piece of text is written in.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text whose language should be detected. Can be a string literal or a cell reference.

basicExample.description: Detect the language of a sentence
basicExample.explanation: The text 'Hola, mundo' is detected as Spanish, returning the code 'es'.

advancedExamples.title: Detect language for a column
advancedExamples.description: Find the language of each support ticket in a list
advancedExamples.explanation: ARRAYFORMULA applies DETECTLANGUAGE to each cell in the range.

howItWorks: DETECTLANGUAGE analyzes the provided text and returns the most likely ISO 639-1 language code. It uses the same language detection service as Google Translate.

howToSteps.name: Select the text
howToSteps.text: Choose the cell or string to analyze.

howToSteps.name: Read the result
howToSteps.text: The result is a two-letter code like 'en', 'es', or 'zh'.

limitations: DETECTLANGUAGE is Google Sheets only and has no native Excel equivalent.
Short texts or mixed languages may be detected incorrectly.
It returns only the language code, not the language name or confidence score.

commonErrors.cause: The input is empty or not valid text.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure the cell contains text and is not blank.

commonErrors.cause: The text is too short or mixed with another language.
commonErrors.fix: Provide more text for better detection accuracy.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: DETECTLANGUAGE is exclusive to Google Sheets. Excel has no built-in language detection function.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Returns ISO 639-1 language codes such as 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja'.

faq.question: Can it detect multiple languages in one cell?
faq.answer: No, it returns a single language code for the entire text.

faq.question: What code does it return for Chinese?
faq.answer: It returns 'zh' for Chinese. Simplified and Traditional are not distinguished.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: No, it requires an internet connection to use Google's language detection service.
